labels.name: iteration-5
labels.description: Iteration 5: more life on the farm and wider reach

issues.title: 🐴 Add a horse for a 200-day streak
issues.body:
## Idea
The dog unlocks at 100 days and then nothing happens, so long streaks have no goal. Add a **horse** that unlocks at a **200-day** streak and wanders the pasture like the cow and the sheep.

## Where to start
- Copy how the sheep was added: `SHEEP_A` / `SHEEP_B` in `src/sprites.js`, `SHEEP_AT` and `unlockedAnimals()` in `src/stats.js`, the `animals.sheep` block with `wander()` in `src/render.js`.
- Add the new threshold to `nextUnlock()` so the sign says "N more days for a horse".
- Update the animals table in the README and the `animals` text in `public/app.js` (both `en` and `es`) and `public/index.html`.

## Done when
- [ ] A 200-day streak shows the horse; 199 does not.
- [ ] It has a still position in `stillCss` (reduced motion).
- [ ] Tests in `test/stats.test.js` and `test/render.test.js` are updated.

issues.title: 🦉 An owl on the fence at night that turns its head
issues.body:
## Idea
Night farms have a moon and fireflies, but the fence birds are asleep. Put a **small owl** on the fence when the farm is in night mode. Every few seconds it turns its head (two or three frames, CSS only).

## Where to start
- Look at how the perched birds (`BIRD_PERCHED`, `BIRD_PECK`) and the cat on the barn are drawn and swapped with CSS in `src/render.js`.
- Only render it when `night` is true.
- Pick the fence spot with `hash()` so it is the same on every run.

## Done when
- [ ] The owl shows at night and never during the day.
- [ ] It looks right with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
- [ ] A test in `test/render.test.js` checks both cases.

issues.title: ⛄ A snowman next to the barn in winter
issues.body:
## Idea
The winter season only changes colors and adds snowfall. Add a **snowman** next to the barn, standing still (a carrot nose and a scarf are enough).

## Where to start
- Seasons are palette plus flags in `src/themes.js`. Add a flag such as `snowman: true` to `winter`.
- Draw the sprite in `src/sprites.js` and place it in `src/render.js` near the barn (see how `BARN` and `SILO` are positioned).
- Read the "Add a seasonal touch" section of `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Done when
- [ ] The snowman shows in winter and in no other season.
- [ ] A test in `test/render.test.js` checks it.

issues.title: 🐝 Bees buzzing around the harvest plots in summer
issues.body:
## Idea
Summer is the one season with no extra touch. Add **two or three bees** that zigzag around fully grown plots.

## Where to start
- The butterflies (`BUTTERFLY_A`/`BUTTERFLY_B` and the `bf*` keyframes in `src/render.js`) are a ready-made example of a looping flight path with a still position for reduced motion.
- Add a `bees` flag to the `summer` theme in `src/themes.js` and pick the plots with `hash()`.

## Done when
- [ ] Bees appear in summer only, and not on night farms.
- [ ] They have a still position in `stillCss`.
- [ ] The size test (`the busiest farm stays under 300 KB`) still passes.

issues.title: 🌈 A rainbow after the shower when weather is on
issues.body:
## Idea
When `weather` is enabled the clouds and the rain loop every 36 seconds. When the shower ends, fade in a **rainbow** in the sky for a few seconds, then fade it out before the next cloud.

## Where to start
- `WEATHER_CYCLE` and the rain/cloud layer in `src/render.js`.
- Opacity-only keyframes are the cheapest option (see `windowed()`).

## Done when
- [ ] The rainbow shows only with `weather: true` and in seasons that have rain (not winter).
- [ ] Reduced motion shows no rainbow, or a still one.
- [ ] A test checks it.

issues.title: 🌾 Map more languages to crops (Solidity, Nim, Gleam, Groovy, TeX, COBOL...)
issues.body:
## Idea
Languages that are not in `LANGUAGE_CROPS` all fall back to 🌾 wheat. Give some of them a better crop, or just a deliberate one.

## Where to start
- `LANGUAGE_CROPS` in `src/crops.js`. Check the list first: Zig, Assembly, Perl, Raku and Crystal are already taken.
- Candidates: Solidity, Nim, Gleam, Groovy, TeX, COBOL, Vim Script, Lisp, Racket, Scheme, Ada, Prolog, Visual Basic.
- Add a few assertions to `test/crops.test.js` and update the table in the README.

## Done when
- [ ] Each new language has a crop, a test and a row in the README table.

issues.title: 🥔 Add a potato crop for the veteran languages
issues.body:
## Idea
A humble **potato** (a leafy top and a few brown tubers peeking out of the soil) for the languages that have been around forever: COBOL, Pascal, Delphi, Ada, Visual Basic, Fortran-era stuff.

## Where to start
- Follow the "Add your crop!" guide in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. The chili and grape PRs (#38) touch exactly the files you need: `src/sprites.js`, `src/crops.js`, `public/app.js`, `public/index.html`, `src/cli.js`, `action.yml`, README and a test.
- Each crop is two 8x8 sprites: `grown` and `harvest`.

## Done when
- [ ] `crop: potato` works in the CLI, the Action and the web generator (English and Spanish).
- [ ] The languages are mapped and tested.

issues.title: 🍉 Add a watermelon crop for the Lisp family
issues.body:
## Idea
A **watermelon** (green rind, red slice on the harvest frame) for Common Lisp, Scheme, Racket and Emacs Lisp. Parentheses and watermelon seeds both come in bunches.

## Where to start
- Same files as any new crop; see the "Add your crop!" guide in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the grape PR (#38) as a template.
- You may need one or two new palette colors in `PALETTE` (`src/sprites.js`).

## Done when
- [ ] `crop: watermelon` works everywhere crops are listed.
- [ ] The languages are mapped and tested.

issues.title: 🌍 More languages for the web generator (Portuguese, French...)
issues.body:
## Idea
The generator speaks English and Spanish. Add **Portuguese** (Brazil has a huge GitHub community) and/or **French**, or any language you speak.

## Where to start
- Copy the `es` block of `TEXTS` in `public/app.js`, translate it, and teach `pickLanguage()` to choose it from the browser locale.
- There is a test that every `data-i18n` key in `public/index.html` exists in every language; it will tell you what is missing.

## Done when
- [ ] A browser set to your language gets the translated page and status messages.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.

issues.title: 📦 Publish to npm so `npx gitfarm` works
issues.body:
## Idea
`package.json` already declares a `bin`, but the package is not on npm. Publishing it lets anyone run `npx gitfarm --user octocat --out farm.svg` without cloning the repo.

## Where to start
- Check what `npm pack --dry-run` includes (`files` field, `.npmignore`) so tests, `tools/` and `examples/` do not ship.
- Make sure `src/cli.js` works when installed (shebang, executable bit, no dependency on repo-relative paths).
- Add a publish job triggered by a GitHub release, and a short section in the README.

## Done when
- [ ] `npm pack` contains only what the CLI needs.
- [ ] A release workflow publishes with provenance.
- [ ] The README documents `npx gitfarm`.

issues.title: 🧢 Farmer hats: straw hat, cap or no hat
issues.body:
## Idea
You can already change the farmer's colors. Add a `hat` option (`straw` default, `cap`, `none`) so the farmer matches you a bit more.

## Where to start
- See how farmer colors are handled in `farmerPalette()` in `src/themes.js` and the `FARMER_A` / `FARMER_B` / `FARMER_WATER` sprites in `src/sprites.js`.
- The new option has to be wired through `src/cli.js`, `action.yml`, the API in `api/` and the web generator form.

## Done when
- [ ] All three hats render for the walking and watering sprites.
- [ ] The option is documented in the README and tested.

issues.title: 🖼️ Visual regression check for the demo farm in CI
issues.body:
## Idea
Pixel art breaks quietly: a sprite shifted by one pixel passes every test. Render the demo farm for each season (and day/night) in CI and compare it with a stored snapshot, so a PR shows exactly what changed visually.

## Where to start
- `tools/record.mjs` already drives Playwright to capture the SVG.
- Start simple: compare the SVG text hash against a committed snapshot, and upload the rendered PNGs as workflow artifacts when it changes.
- Provide a one-line command to update the snapshots on purpose.

## Done when
- [ ] CI fails when the output changes without updating snapshots.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING explains how to update them.
